connector:W002-P2: mating: cable end for RW1-J02 (RW1); part EX-MICROD-21-M mates with EX-MICROD-21-F

harness:W001: segmentation: IF-001 share a harness because they have the same pair of unit connectors and chain (nominal)
harness:W002: segmentation: IF-002 share a harness because they have the same pair of unit connectors and chain (nominal)
pin:PCDU1-J01.1: pin-allocation: PWR of IF-001 (power and return grouped)
pin:PCDU1-J01.2: pin-allocation: RTN of IF-001 (power and return grouped)
pin:PCDU1-J03.1: pin-allocation: TX+ of IF-002 (pair TX on adjacent pins)
pin:PCDU1-J03.2: pin-allocation: TX- of IF-002 (pair TX on adjacent pins)
pin:PCDU1-J03.3: pin-allocation: RX+ of IF-002 (pair RX on adjacent pins)
pin:PCDU1-J03.4: pin-allocation: RX- of IF-002 (pair RX on adjacent pins)
pin:RW1-J01.1: pin-allocation: PWR of IF-001 (power and return grouped)
pin:RW1-J01.2: pin-allocation: RTN of IF-001 (power and return grouped)
pin:RW1-J02.1: pin-allocation: TX+ of IF-002 (pair TX on adjacent pins)
pin:RW1-J02.2: pin-allocation: TX- of IF-002 (pair TX on adjacent pins)
pin:RW1-J02.3: pin-allocation: RX+ of IF-002 (pair RX on adjacent pins)
pin:RW1-J02.4: pin-allocation: RX- of IF-002 (pair RX on adjacent pins)
wire:W001-001: wiring: PWR of IF-001 connects PCDU1-J01 pin 1 to RW1-J01 pin 1 (X drives)
wire:W001-002: wiring: RTN of IF-001 connects PCDU1-J01 pin 2 to RW1-J01 pin 2 (X drives)
wire:W002-001: wiring: TX+/RX+ of IF-002 connects PCDU1-J03 pin 1 to RW1-J02 pin 3 (X drives)
wire:W002-002: wiring: TX+/RX+ of IF-002 connects RW1-J02 pin 1 to PCDU1-J03 pin 3 (Y drives)
wire:W002-003: wiring: TX-/RX- of IF-002 connects PCDU1-J03 pin 2 to RW1-J02 pin 4 (X drives)
wire:W002-004: wiring: TX-/RX- of IF-002 connects RW1-J02 pin 2 to PCDU1-J03 pin 4 (Y drives)
